name: Mrs. Paddock
role: Medora woman who hosted visiting women
bio: Mrs. Paddock hosted visitors in Medora, including a Mrs. McGregor in 1885 and 1886 and, in August 1885, the sister of Bob Roberts, who had come with him from Wales. In April 1885 the paper announced a birth in the Paddock household.

moments.label: Birth announced in the Paddock household
Hosted Roberts' sister, newly arrived from Wales

mentions: Mrs. J. A. McGregor is in from the ranch visiting Mrs. Paddock.
And now there is rejoicing in the house of Paddock. Tuesday afternoon there was born to Mrs. Paddock, a fourteen pound girl baby. The mother and child are both doing well.
…ccompanied him on his recent trip from Wales, arrived here from Bismarck last week and is now a guest of Mrs. Paddock.
Mrs. J. A. McGregor arrived in Medora last week and is visiting with Mrs. Paddock. She will start in a few days for her home in Berlin Heights, Ohio, where she will spend the winter.
